- **M4 Audio remains unplaced.** Taste Gate 3/audio is unscheduled relative to P1–P5—not silently assigned to P5—until an explicit ruling places it. `epoch0-main/docs/program/PROGRAM.md:25-37`; `epoch0-main/docs/program/PRODUCT.md:220-228,242`
